**Finding: NOSOLICIT — compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant binding the Company. I checked the planner's neighbourhood (Section 5.4 General Managers) and read the whole document, plus regex searches for "solicit / employ / hire / induce / recruit / personnel". The only hits are incidental: HDI's "employees, or agents" in the confidentiality carve-out (p0051) and the independent-contractor language (p0061). The document's restrictive covenants are the Section 6 exclusivity/brand provisions (p0037, p0042), which are commercial field restrictions, not personnel restrictions — and those belong to a different rule, so I have not flagged them here.

Since the preferred position is the *absence* of a non-solicit on the Customer, the clause set is compliant and no redline was proposed. Noted in the rationale (not as a deviation) that the silence is symmetrical — we also have no non-solicit protection against HDI — but the playbook does not require us to add one.
